newsitem.title: USA: Kansas fed cattle Wednesday roundup - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Kansas fed cattle Wednesday roundup - USDA.

text.p: Trade was quiet until noon when it turned active, USDA said. Slaughter steers and heifers were steady with last week. Inquiry good, demand light early, good later.
Wk to date- 80,900 last week - 76,600 last year - 53,300

Sales were confirmed on 36,200 slaughter steers and 28,900 slaughter heifers Wednesday. For the week to date 80,900 head confirmed including 23,200 head or about 29 percent previously contracted or formulated cattle. Sales FOB feedlot net weights after 4 percent shrink.

Slaughter steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1100-1300 lbs 64.00, few early 63.00; few Select with end Choice 1275 lbs 63.50; pen Select and Choice 1235-1350 lb Holsteins 57.00-59.00. Dressed basis - Few Select and Choice 1200-1250 lbs 104.00.
Slaughter heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 1020-1150 lbs 64.00; few Select with end Choice 1025 lbs 63.50. Dressed basis - Few mixed Commercial to Choice heifers with end heiferettes 101.00.
